skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and remember the concept, role, and significance of business ethics for sustainable development.
Understand and remember the levels of micro, meso, macro ethics and their relationship with individual behavior, organizational behavior, and social behavior.
Understand and remember the concept of corporate social responsibility (CSR), the obligations of companies towards society, and different approaches to CSR issues.
Understand and remember the concept and nature of responsible business practices, responsible businesses, and their alignment with societal sustainable development goals.
Understand and remember the concept and basic content of social capital in business, and the role of social capital in the sustainable development of businesses.
Know the process and methods for developing a code of conduct for an organization/business.
Have the ability to apply and implement the code of conduct in an organization/business.
Know the process and methods for developing an ethics program (BEP) for a business organization.
Know how to apply and implement ethics programs in a business organization.
Have the ability to identify ethical issues arising in business activities, and be sensitive to ethical issues.
Have the skills to analyze the origins of conflicts arising in business activities.
Have the ability to apply problem-solving tools, methods, and processes to address business ethical issues.
Have the ability to propose reasonable solutions to address business ethical issues.
Demonstrate personal autonomy and responsibility for the development of the organization/business they participate in.
Proactively propose solutions to fulfill social responsibility for the organization/business they participate in.
Demonstrate initiative and creativity in applying the knowledge from this course to the sustainable development of the organization/business and society.
